Many neutrophil cell… 9225850 non-canonical-pi3k-cdc42-pak-mek-erk-signaling-promotes-immune-complex-induced-apoptosis-in-human-neutrophils non canonical pi3k cdc42 pak mek erk signaling Neutrophils are peripheral blood leukocytes that represent the first line of immune cell d Non-canonical PI3K-Cdc42-Pak-Mek-Erk Signaling Promotes Immune-Complex-Induced Apoptosis in Human Neutrophils Neutrophils are peripheral blood leukocytes that represent the first line of immune cell defense against bacterial and fungal infections but are also crucial players in the generation of the inflammatory response. Many neutrophil cell surface receptors regulate important cellular processes via activation of agonist-activated PI3Ks. We show here that activation of human neutrophils with insoluble immune complexes drives a previously uncharacterized, PI3K-dependent, non-canonical, pro-apoptotic signaling pathway, FcγR-PI3Kβ/δ-Cdc42-Pak-Mek-Erk.
